﻿﻿This mod adds 40 pieces of furniture for you to build your very own farmer's market.
This add-on to Farmer's Market core adds bakery furniture. If you come close enough, you can even smell the scent of fresh bread!

[size=4]Recolors available via config! Choose from Classic, Light or Dark
